comment: P367: one GLOBAL Rust crate allowlist, identical for every item. `crates` is what a model may name in [dependencies] and what the disclosure line lists; `vendor` lists every (crate, requirement) vendored offline: current versions plus the exact older ones the references need. Reference-only crates (counter, permutohedron) are vendored but NEVER listed in `crates` (naming them would hint the reference approach); freeze-time reference trees are checked with them as explicit extras. Requirements are disjoint major ranges so cargo cannot unify an old and a current version of one crate.
